basic_details.job_title: Kumuram Bheem Asifabad District Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Typist & Senior Superintendent Posts
basic_details.short_information: District and Sessions Court, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad has announced 2 contract vacancies for Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) and Typist posts under advertisement number Dis.No.1555/2026/Admn. Candidates must submit their offline applications by post or courier to The Prl. District and Sessions Judge, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad on or before 31 October 2026. Qualifications vary by post, with the Senior Superintendent requiring graduation and retired Judicial Employee status from the Senior Superintendent category, while the Typist post requires a Bachelor's Degree, higher grade English Typewriting,

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be addressed to the Prl. District and Sessions Judge, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad in a sealed cover. The application form along with enclosures must be sent by way of post or by way of courier. Applications will not be entertained either directly or in person. Candidates must enclose a self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgment worth of Rs. 70/- or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD. Candidates must use the application form provided in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The individual must not have completed 65 years of age. Only persons who have retired as members of Telangana Judicial Ministerial Service alone will be considered. Persons who have retired in the corresponding or higher categories of Telangana Judicial Ministerial Service will be considered for the respective posts. Only persons who are of sound health and active habits alone will be considered. Persons with proven record of ability, good performance and integrity alone will be considered. Persons who have been awarded any punishments for any misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service are not eligible for consideration. Selected persons must produce a physical fitness certificate and enter into an agreement/contract with the District Court, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad. In case of non-availability of Retired Ministerial Staff of Judicial Department, candidates from outside will be considered. For outsiders: Age Limit: As on 01.07.2026, a candidate must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 46 years. Age Relaxation: Relaxation of maximum age limit in respect of SCs, STs, BCs, and EWS is 5 years, and for candidates with physical disabilities, it is 10 years. Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk) Qualification: Must be a graduate and retired Judicial Employee from the category of Senior Superintendent. Typist Qualification: (i) Must have passed Bachelor's Degree of any University in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any equivalent qualification. (ii) Must have passed Telangana Government Technical examination in English Typewriting by higher grade qualification or its equivalent examination. (iii) Must have knowledge or qualification in computer operation. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Certificate of academic qualifications such as marks lists, pass certificate, provisional certificate, testimonials, and other certificates to prove technical efficiency if any. Date of Birth certificate. Community certificate in case of SCs, STs, and BCs issued by the competent authority. Employment Registration Card. Certificate in respect of Local and Non-local candidature in terms of Presidential Order, 1975. A self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgment worth of Rs. 70/- or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is made on contract basis as per Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Rules, 1996 for a period of one year in the Fast Track Special Court for Expeditious Trial and Disposal of Rape and POCSO Act Cases, Asifabad. For the post of Typist, there will be a test in Typewriting with regard to technical efficiency, and qualified candidates will be called for an oral interview. For posts of Senior Superintendent and Typist, those who have higher academic and technical qualifications will be given due consideration.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit applications for the Kumuram Bheem Asifabad District Court recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit filled-in applications by post or courier is 31 October 2026 up to 05.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q2. Are retired judicial employees eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, applications are primarily invited from retired Telangana Judicial Ministerial Servants who have not completed 65 years of age. Outsiders are considered only in case of non-availability of retired ministerial staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the duration of the contract appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contract basis for a period of one year as per Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Rules, 1996.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for outsider candidates applying as Typist?
faq.answer: Outsider candidates must have completed 18 years and must not have completed 46 years of age as on 01.07.2026, with age relaxations of 5 years for SC, ST, BC, and EWS candidates, and 10 years for persons with physical disabilities.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Typist post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a test in Typewriting to test technical efficiency, and qualified candidates will subsequently be called for an oral interview.
